claims.evidence: No brand name, logo, or country-of-manufacture text is legible on any tire sidewall in the three photos; 'major distributor' is a business reputation claim that no photo can confirm.

risks.risk: Tire brand and origin (e.g. genuinely Belgian-made vs. generic/unbranded) cannot be confirmed
risks.proof: Close-up photo of a sidewall clearly showing brand name and 'Made in Belgium' or equivalent molded text

risks.risk: Tire size (width/profile/rim diameter) varies across the stacks and is not legible
risks.proof: Close-up of sidewall size code (e.g. 205/55R16) for each distinct stack/batch
risks.if_unproven: priced at the lowest common size tier until sizes are confirmed

risks.risk: Manufacture date (DOT code) unknown, so tires could be old/perished rubber
risks.proof: Close-up of DOT date code on sidewall
risks.if_unproven: priced as old stock / near end-of-life rubber

risks.risk: Tread depth and real wear level not measurable from a distance
risks.proof: Photo with a tread depth gauge or coin inserted in the groove

risks.risk: Hidden punctures, patches, bulges, or internal cord damage
risks.proof: Close-up photos of each tire's full sidewall and inner surface, plus any patch/plug marks

risks.risk: Number of tires in the lot and whether sold per piece or as a set is unclear
risks.proof: A count photo or seller-provided itemized list matching a wide shot of all stacks
risks.if_unproven: priced per single tire at worst-case condition, not as a bulk set

proof_requests: Close-up of sidewall showing brand, size code, and DOT date for each distinct stack
Tread depth gauge or coin photo on at least 3 sample tires per stack
Full-circumference photos of 3-5 sample tires showing inner sidewall and tread for puncture/patch/bulge check
A count/inventory photo or video clarifying total number of tires and per-unit vs lot sale terms
response.reason: The witness confirms this is a bulk lot of used, mixed-size tires with no legible brand or condition detail, so it can be priced at worst case as generic unbranded used tires pending the listed proofs; the seller's Belgium-distributor claim is unverifiable from the photos and should not raise the price.
